verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents interacting with a scraped page by clicking, filling forms and navigating deeper, and offers managed browser sessions for interactive workflows. That gives an agent a route past simple form walls and possibly logins. Its 96% web-coverage claim hints at some anti-bot handling, but nothing in the pack shows CAPTCHA solving or automated login and session handling. Missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA bypass or solving, documented automated login and credential handling, hands-on evidence of getting past anti-bot walls without manual intervention.
